name: Twilight Mote
description: Flick a mote that is half bright and half dim so its edge is hard to follow.

name: Edge Sense
description: Feel the line where light gives way to shade and any body that stands upon it.

name: Boundary Guard
description: Hold a hand on the line of bright and dim to turn a blow toward the dark side.

name: Shade Flash
description: Flash between bright and dark so fast that the foe cannot tell which they face.

name: Dim Beam
description: Fire a beam that shows nothing along its length and burns only where it lands.

name: Gloom Screen
description: Hang a screen of shade lit from behind that swallows rays and softens blows.

name: Eclipse Lance
description: Drive a lance whose point is bright and whose shaft is dark through the guard in one thrust.

name: Twilight Wave
description: Roll a wave of dusk-coloured light across the ground that burns and bewilders at once.

name: Perception Rift
description: Tear the line of sight open so that foes cannot trust what they see and lose their working.

name: Shade Crown
description: streams: Light + Darkness; Bring a ring of bright and shade together over a foe so that it burns them and weighs down all their senses.

name: Flash Arc
description: Throw a flash with a crackling arc along its edge that stings on contact.

name: Spark Beat
description: Beat a spark through the legs to take one quick stride sideways.

name: Static Gleam
description: Spread a faint charged gleam round the body and feel it crackle where a body comes near.

name: Arc Lance
description: Lance a bright arc through the guard so the shock runs up the arm.

name: Charged Beam
description: Charge a beam till it cracks and fire it so that it jolts the whole body of the target.

name: Bolt Guard
description: Cross the forearms in a crackle of light to throw a blow aside with a jolt.

name: Quick Pulse
description: Pulse charged light through the limbs for a burst of quickness in the next few moves.

name: Chain Beam
description: Fire a beam that leaps from one foe to the next and burns each in turn.

name: Bolt Radiance
description: Flash the whole field white with a crack that stuns and scorches those within.

name: Streak Burst
description: Flash to the far side of the foe at the speed of a bolt and strike on arrival.

name: Thunder Dawn
description: streams: Light + Lightning; Drop a bolt of daylight that cracks and blazes together and pierces whatever it strikes.

name: Gentle Lumen
description: Rest a gentle light on an ally's cut and let it close the edges.

name: Warm Mote
description: Press a warm mote into the user's own sore muscle to ease the cramp.

name: Healing Ward
description: Hold a ward of warm light over an ally who is being treated.

name: Calm Gleam
description: Hold a calm gleam over an ally's chest until the breath and pulse settle.

name: Mend Beam
description: Send a mending beam into a deep wound and hold it while the flesh fills.

name: Clean Radiance
description: Spread a clean radiance over a festering wound and burn the corruption from it.

name: Restoring Pulse
description: Beat a single strong pulse of restoring light through an ally's chest to refill their strength.

name: Soothe Flare
description: Flare a soft light over a scorched ally to cool the burn and clear the stain.

name: Knit Light
description: Spread a field of knitting light in which every ally's wounds draw closed together.

name: Pulse Restore
description: Restore the pulse of one whose heart has just stopped within a short window; it never returns the long dead.

name: Whole Mending
description: Mend a grave wound completely and burn every trace of taint from it in one long pour of light.

name: Living Dawn
description: streams: Light + Healing; Raise a dawn over the wounded that mends all flesh in reach and rekindles a pulse just failed.
